purpose: Define the minimum retained evidence required before M-004, M-005, or M-006 may be classified as located or unlocated after exhaustive repository coverage.

coverage_predicates.requirement: Retain every accessible branch name and immutable head commit SHA, including pagination metadata and retrieval time.
fail_closed_when: branch listing is empty without independent repository evidence
a branch head lacks an immutable SHA

coverage_predicates.requirement: Traverse parent links from every retained branch head until each lineage reaches an already-retained commit or a root commit; retain commit SHAs and parent SHAs.
fail_closed_when: a retained commit has an untraversed parent
a branch head is absent from the reachable set
history is sampled rather than closed

coverage_predicates.requirement: Retain each reachable commit tree SHA and an inventory of paths and blob SHAs needed to search identifier assignments and provenance records.
fail_closed_when: a reachable commit lacks a tree inventory

coverage_predicates.requirement: Search immutable retained text objects for exact identifiers and semantically linked assignment language; retain query grammar, candidate locators, and rejected candidates.
fail_closed_when: only indexed code search is used
search terms or scope are not retained
namespace collisions are accepted without owner and semantic-role agreement

coverage_predicates.requirement: A located result must agree on namespace, owner, semantic role, temporal precedence, and immutable locator; otherwise remain unresolved.
fail_closed_when: a candidate is reconstructed from prose
identifier suffix alone is treated as identity
the originating assignment object is missing

allowed_claims.located: Allowed only when one immutable originating object satisfies every origin-resolution predicate.
allowed_claims.unlocated_after_exhaustive_coverage: Allowed only when every coverage predicate is verified and no qualifying immutable originating object exists.
allowed_claims.unresolved: Required whenever any coverage predicate or origin-resolution predicate remains unverified.

observed: Canonical queue requires exhaustive branch inventory or equivalent repository-history traversal.
The retained source-class ledger records all-branches-and-reachable-history coverage as unresolved.
An empty branch-search response was observed but does not include a retained branch inventory or coverage proof.
inferred: The empty branch-search response is interface-bounded and cannot establish that the repository has no accessible branches.
proposed: Implement two independent branch/ref enumerators and reconcile their branch-name and head-SHA sets before commit traversal.
unresolved: Complete reachable commit and tree sets
Immutable originating objects for M-004, M-005, and M-006

privacy_boundary: Retain repository paths, object SHAs, classification metadata, and bounded excerpts only when public-repository-safe. Do not copy private chat or personal source text into repository artifacts.
reversibility: Additive contract. Revert its creating commit without altering canonical state, queue, registry, trigger ledger, or prior history.
